<thought>We have five oxide polymorph files already. To stay within tool limits, I will retrieve the remaining oxides in two smaller batches. First, I will get polymorphs for ten more oxides (ZnO, MgO, CaO, SrO, BaO, CoO, NiO, MnO, Cr2O3, V2O5) with the required filters and save them to the existing “oxides_data” directory.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": ["ZnO", "MgO", "CaO", "SrO", "BaO", "CoO", "NiO", "MnO", "Cr2O3", "V2O5"],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}
